title: Incorrect attribute check
detail: The condition is inverted; it warns and returns a version for any attribute other than `__version__`, causing unintended behavior for all missing attributes.
note: Describes the planted flip: every attribute but __version__ takes the deprecation path.

title: Wrong package name in version lookup
detail: The code attempts to fetch the version of the Werkzeug package instead of Jinja2, which will raise PackageNotFoundError if Werkzeug is not installed and return an incorrect version otherwise.

title: Accessing flags on non-Failure objects
detail: The code checks that response is not a twisted Failure, then accesses response.flags. If response is a normal Response object (or any object without a flags attribute), this will raise an AttributeError, causing the timeout handler to crash.

title: Incorrect width returned for special table entries
detail: The table can contain a width of -1 to indicate a zero-width character. The original code returned 0 in that case, but the new code returns -1, causing cell_len to report a negative width for such characters.
